text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to build Jordan's talents even 
more, she and I are taking part 
in the 
summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Raaah! All right, one more lap! Come on, 
Trainer, let's go extra hard 
today! Uraugh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally Tosen! I wanna go to the festival 
tonight in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, didn't you hear? There's a HUGE 
festival tonight at a nearby 
shrine!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And I'm hella stoked for it. I'm 100% going, so don't you DARE extend practice today. I'll make sure we finish everything on time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait a minute... If you didn't know, 
that means you weren't 
planning on going 
to the festival, right? Got something else 
planned 
then?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You're one serious trainer, all right. 
Well, whatever. I'm gonna 
go warm up for 
the next exercise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, true to her word, Tosen Jordan 
gives practice her all. Once 
we finish, she 
swiftly makes her way to the festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or at least, I thought she would...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are. Come on, we're headed 
out.
choice_data_list: Wait, what about the summer festival?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I am, and you're coming with me. Now let's 
hurry up and go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You know, I'm pretty goated when it comes to carnival games, but someone's gotta carry my prizes. Can't eat cotton candy with full hands, now, can I?
choice_data_list: And that's why you chose me?
And that's why you chose me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sure do. And since I don't hear a "no," I'm 
guessing you're okay with 
it? Good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, I find myself half-dragged over 
to the summer festival.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh. My. GOSH. What are you doing here?! And wearing a yukata too! And—hold on, isn't that your crush?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Shhh! Don't be so loud! This is why I didn't 
tell anyone I was coming!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right, I bet you wanted to show off! 
Anyway, I better get 
evidence for later. 
Trainer, take a picture of us! Say cheeeese!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You don't have anyone to take a photo of 
you two together, do you? 
I'll take one. I'll 
even make it super cute before I send it to 
you. Make 
a peace sign!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's with these chocolate bananas? They're practically glow sticks. I'm gonna go blind!

text_block_list.name: Game Operator
text_block_list.text:
Gimme a break, kid. I'm trying to keep up 
with the times! You 
youngsters like taking 
pictures, right? I thought these would be 
good, 
but did I go too far?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way! This is PEAK festival cuisine! I 
100% stan these banans. I'll 
take one. 
How about you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What, you scared? This is literally a banana glow-up. Get in here and get your hands covered in neon chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha! You looked so serious there! 
Well, glad you're getting into 
the vibes. 
Let's take a selfie with these two bananas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue to explore the festival, and 
I'm surprised by how much 
fun we're 
having. We may not be close friends, but 
we seem to enjoy 
each other's company.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boom...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Fireworks! Now this is giving festival.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You do?! We finally found something we 
have in common, then! Huh, 
I had no 
idea...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Although, I guess there aren't many people who hate fireworks. Guess we're not really vibing after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean... We're so different, you know? I 
was just thinking, wouldn't it 
be nice if we 
had, like, one thing in common?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That way, even if we are from different planets, we can at least enjoy something together. Guess I've been kinda worried about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So that's why she brought me to the 
festival. She's been trying to 
connect with 
me, in her own way.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks aren't the best common interest, 
huh... Yeah, no good. 
Guess we're gonna 
be stuck as complete strangers, huh?
choice_data_list: It's fine even if you don't know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While we may not understand each other, we've both shown that we want to. If Tosen Jordan has taught me anything, it's that the desire to understand is what's most important.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Um... Whatever. I still think it'd be better 
if we vibed more.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whether it'd be food, comedy, clothes, or just... vibes. It'd be so much better and easier if we were the same.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's annoying studying stuff we 
don't understand, right? Like, 
watching 
UmaToks or comedy shows you don't find 
funny just feels so 
cringe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But... If that's how it's gotta be, I guess I'm 
okay with it. At least we 
agree that 
fireworks are pretty...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can still feel some distance from Tosen 
Jordan as she mumbles away. 
However, I 
know that the more we talk, the more that 
distance will 
close itself.
